proposal.decision: Proceed with one bounded bill/root macro construction trial; do not treat it as a seam-only polish pass.
proposal.smallest_intervention: Replace only the visible generic bill shell and its narrow bill-saddle strips with two coupled formed curved bill plates plus bilateral compact root returns. Derive the exterior from the existing deep-hook scaffold. A dorsal root cuff slips beneath the existing crown root; a broad distal hook plate wraps the existing deep hook and tip. The root returns fold back into the anterior under-eye cheek boundary, keeping a real open gape. Use a broad source-readable lap boundary and real inward/downturned returns, not floating seam wires.
